// THE ONLY ACCOUNT-SPECIFIC NODE (CLAUDE.md). Fill in the REPLACE_WITH_ values in Phase 3 (docs/SETUP.md, Phase 2).
const cfg = {
  "firmName": "Tallgrass Advisory",
  "timezone": "America/Chicago",
  "weekStartOverride": "",
  "demoMode": true,
  "ownerEmail": "owner@tallgrassadvisory.example",
  "revenueLabel": "Revenue (as entered)",
  "pipelineId": "default",
  "pulseFolderId": "REPLACE_WITH_FOLDER_ID_Pulse",
  "inputSheetId": "REPLACE_WITH_SHEET_ID_N3_weekly_numbers",
  "inputTab": "weekly",
  "definitionsTab": "definitions",
  "ledgerSheetId": "REPLACE_WITH_SHEET_ID_N3_ledger",
  "ledgerTab": "runs",
  "errorsTab": "errors",
  "wonStages": [
    "closedwon"
  ],
  "lostStages": [
    "closedlost"
  ],
  "hubspotMaxPages": 20,
  "thresholds": {
    "revenueSwingBp": 2500,
    "cashDropBp": 1000,
    "overdueFlagMin": 3,
    "quietMaxNewContacts": 2
  },
  "model": "claude-sonnet-5-5",
  "maxOutputTokens": 1500,
  "weeklyCallCap": 3,
  "perRunTokenCeiling": 20000,
  "weeklySpendCapUsd": 1,
  "priceInputPerMTokUsd": null,
  "priceOutputPerMTokUsd": null,
  "alertWebhookUrl": ""
};
return [{ json: { ...cfg, _runAt: new Date().toISOString() } }];
